description:
Configure a new tax type for California sales tax in the Drupal Commerce store. 

Navigate to Commerce > Configuration > Tax types and add a new tax type with the following settings:
- Label: 'California State Sales Tax'
- Plugin: Custom
- Configuration settings:
  - Display taxes of this type inclusive in product prices: No (unchecked)
  - Round tax at the order item level: Yes (checked)
  - Zone:
    - Label: 'California'
    - Territories: United States > California
    - Tax rates: Label 'Standard', Percentage '0.0725' (7.25%)

Save the tax type. It must be present in the configuration list to pass.
